intuition.definition:
n. instinctive knowing (without the use of rational processes)
n. an impression that something might be the case
intuition.translation: n. 直觉, 直觉的知识

intuitional.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or derived from, intuition;
   characterized by intuition; perceived by intuition; intuitive.
intuitional.translation: a. 直觉的, 直观的

n. The doctrine that the perception or recognition of

   sensationalism, and experientialism.
intuitionalism.translation: n. (=intuitionism) 直觉说, 直观论

intuitionalist.definition: n. One who holds the doctrine of intuitionalism.
intuitionalist.translation:
n. 直觉主义者
a. 直觉主义的

intuitionism.translation: n. 直觉说, 直观论

intuitionist.translation:
n. 直觉主义者
a. 直觉主义的

intuitionists.definition:
plural of intuitionist
a of or relating to intuitionism

(intuitionist 的复数) n.直觉主义者
a. 直觉主义的

intuitions.definition:
n. instinctive knowing (without the use of rational processes)
n. an impression that something might be the case
intuitions.translation: n. 直觉( intuition的复数形式 ); 凭直觉感知的知识; 直觉力

intuitive.definition:

s. obtained through intuition rather than from reasoning or observation
